hints.title: Write the logarithms as powers
hints.body: Use logab=c to mean b=ac. Rewrite both given equations this way.
hints.recap: A logarithm tells you the power of its base.
hints.pitfall: Keep the base and the number being logged in the right places.

recall.reminder: A logarithm tells you the power of its base.

hints.title: Remove the middle variable
hints.body: Substitute your expression for y into the equation for z. Combine the powers, then rearrange to make x a power of z.
hints.recap: When a power is raised to a power, multiply the exponents.
hints.pitfall: The question asks for a logarithm with base z.
hints.pause: Read the requested logarithm from your final power equation.

recall.reminder: When a power is raised to a power, multiply the exponents.

solution:
The given equations mean y=xz and z=yx. Substituting gives z=(xz)x=xxz.

Taking logarithms to base z gives 1=xzlogzx, hence logzx=1xz. All divisions and logarithms are valid because x,z>1.

Answer: F.
knowledgePattern: Convert linked logarithms to powers and recover the reverse logarithm
